Browser Buffer is vendored from the exact npm archives in sources.json, verified against their SHA-512 integrity values. Each index.js is wrapped in an exports closure, its two require calls refer to the preceding dependency closures, and the Buffer exports are exposed as ESM. Upstream sources: https://github.com/feross/buffer, https://github.com/beatgammit/base64-js, https://github.com/feross/ieee754. Licenses are retained in LICENSES.txt. No npm or Node.js installation is needed to build or publish an NSH app.
